questions.text:
Thank you for sitting down with me. I don't know where to start with that thing.
The hospital said she made one call before the ambulance came. It wasn't to me. 😔
Who did she call?
questions.hint: Check the recent calls in her Phone app.

questions.text:
I don't know anybody by that name. Not from church, not from anywhere.
The woman at the bank said money's been leaving her account every month for years. I didn't take in the figures.
How much went out each time?

That's more than our grocery bill.
Once a month she went out around noon. Said it was a church thing, and I never asked twice.
What did she call those monthly outings?
questions.hint: Look through her Messages, then her Calendar.

questions.text:
She never used that word with me. Not once in forty-one years.
She'd come home from those lunches smelling of fryer grease and coffee.
Where exactly were they eating?
questions.hint: Check her saved places in Maps.

questions.text:
We used to go there, her and me, back when I was still working. 🥲
I suppose that Jonah is who she was buying lunch for.
What is he studying?
questions.hint: Look through older conversations in Messages.

questions.text:
She'd have liked that. She always said the nurses held every clinic together. ❤️
Four hundred a month and a boy in school. I can add.
Which school was her money going to?
questions.hint: Start in RevoBank, then search her Mail.

onboarding.text: My wife died three weeks ago. A stroke, right there in our kitchen. I was at the hardware store buying a hinge. Her phone's been sitting on the counter since. I can't bring myself to move it.
onboarding.label: Gus Halvorsen

onboarding.text: That's my wife. Thirty years cleaning teeth in Eau Claire. Church every Sunday, crossword in pen, never wasted a dime. I'd have told you I knew every corner of her.
onboarding.label: Ilse Halvorsen

onboarding.text: Closing her bank account, I found money going out every month. Years of it. Then the hospital told me she made one phone call before the ambulance came. It wasn't to me.
onboarding.label: Ilse Halvorsen

onboarding.text: I'm no good with these phones. You are. Go through it for me, one thing at a time. Whatever's in there, I'd rather hear it from you than lie awake guessing.
onboarding.label: Gus & Ilse

msgs.text: Went to Petersen's for a cleaning. The new girl scaled me like she's afraid of me 😄
Be kind, we were all new once
You were never afraid in your life
I was terrified my first month. I hid in the supply closet
I remember. You came out smelling like fluoride varnish
Knee surgery is set for June 16. Scared
You'll do fine. I'll bring meals the first week. Don't argue
I won't argue. I've learned
Good. Any allergies I need to know about?
Just to ex-husbands 😂
In pre-op. They gave me a paper hat
Send a picture
No
Thinking of you. Gus says hello and good luck
Alive. Loopy. The nurse is lovely
Thank God. I'll be by at noon tomorrow with soup
Please bring the chicken wild rice
Already in the pot
Walking with the walker like a retired snail
Snails get there eventually
Philosopher
Door County in September? My sister got a cottage for the week. You and Gus could come up for a night
That sounds wonderful. I'll ask Gus. He'll say 'we'll see' which means yes
Ha! Lars was the same
Gus said 'we'll see' 😄
Told you!
Ilse, are you watching the cooking competition tonight? The pie episode!
I am. Gus fell asleep in the recliner ten minutes in.
Of course he did 😂
Do you remember old Dr. Petersen's bow ties?
The little sailboats! I wanted one
He gave me one for Christmas once. It's in a drawer
Heading to the thrift store tomorrow. Want to come along?
Yes! I need a basket for yarn.
Found a lovely wicker one for $4. Buy it before I do.
Hold it, I'm on my way.
Can I send you a recipe? It's Joyce's zucchini bread
Please! Gus's garden is giving us ten zucchini a week
Ten? Lock your doors
I've been leaving them on neighbors' porches at night
That's how it starts. You become the zucchini bandit
My daughter wants me to get a smartphone with a bigger screen. I like this one.
Keep it till it dies. Mine is held together with a case and prayer.
Church picnic is the 12th. I'm making deviled eggs.
I'll bring the potato salad. Gus will bring himself 😄
That's all we ask.
Home from the follow-up. Surgeon says I can drive
Wonderful! Come for supper next week. Pork chops
I'll bring the pie
Bring yourself. I have pie
Then I'll bring wine and pretend it's not wine
Still on for supper this weekend?
Yes! Six o'clock, pork chops, and bring your appetite
Wouldn't miss it
I keep calling you and it goes to voicemail. Please call me. I heard something awful
Oh Ilse. Dale called me. I can't believe it. We were supposed to have supper
I sat in the third row. Your hymn was beautiful. I held Gus's hand at the end, he squeezed back and I almost broke
I keep reaching for my phone to send you something funny
I saw a sailboat bow tie in a shop window today. I stood there crying like a fool
I'm bringing pork chops to Gus. Don't laugh. I'm a terrible cook
I'll keep texting. I hope that's alright. It helps
Ilse! Lunch soon? It's been since Christmas.
Yes. I'm free all next week except the day I get my hair done.
How about April 16? Soup place on Water Street.
Perfect. They have the wild rice.
That's the one 😋
Running 5 min late, parking is awful.
No rush, I have a booth.
Good to see you. I forget how much I miss you roasting Dr. Pete's old ties.
Those ties were a crime. The one with the fish!
THE FISH. 😂
Did you hear Karen Petersen is taking over the practice fully? Dr. Pete is finally retiring for real.
About time. Thirty-one years. We should do a card.
I'll organize it. Ten dollars each?
Count me in. I'll drop it off.
Found your old scrub top pattern at the thrift store. The teal one with the little teeth. Remember?
Stop it, I wore that for ten years.
Nobody ever forgot it.
Ilse! Is the yard sale still on for the 6th?
It is. I'm pricing everything tonight. Gus found three boxes of old dental magazines 🙄
Keep them, someone will buy them for the crossword pages.
Door County in September? Me and Pat have a cabin booked, there's a third bed.
Oh I'd love that. Let me check with Gus. He'll say fine, he always says fine.
Mention the fish fry. That seals it.
😂 Mention noted. I'll let you know by June.
Gus says go. He's going to hold down the fort.
Yay!! November 20 to 21. Don't forget your walking shoes.
Walking shoes, check. And I'm bringing the puzzle.
Of course you are.
Sold the lamp for $15. Dad's old lamp. Gus nodded and said nothing.
Ha, that's love.
Are you free for lunch next week? I'll treat.
I'd love that. Not Wednesday, I have a thing.
Thursday then. Noon at the sandwich place on Barstow?
Perfect.
Sciatica is killing me. Do you still have that stretch sheet from the practice?
I do somewhere. I'll look tonight and drop it in your mailbox.
You are a lifesaver.
Found it, it's in your mailbox. Do the cat-cow ones slowly.
Slowly. Got it. Thank you!
That soup was so good. Thank you for listening to me ramble about Frank's back.
You never ramble. Tell Frank to see the chiropractor.
I'll nag him. 😘
Cabin owner wants a deposit. $60 each.
Mailed you a check this morning.
Got it, thanks! Four more months of waiting 😆
Ilse. I just got Karen's call. I don't have words.
I'm so sorry. I'm so so sorry.
I saw Gus at the service. He looked so small in that big flannel. I held his hand.
I canceled the cabin. Didn't feel right going. The $60 you sent is in an envelope for Gus whenever he wants it.
Still thinking about you every morning on my walk.
Hi Ilse, Gary Nystrom Lawn Care. Spring cleanup slots open next week. Want me on the list?
Yes please. Front and back beds, and the leaves behind the shed.
Will do. $120 for the cleanup. Mowing starts mid-April at $45 a cut.
That's fine. Gus will complain about the price but his knees won't let him do the beds anymore.
😄 Understood.
Cleanup done. Left the bags by the curb for pickup.
Looks wonderful. I'll mail the check today.
Thank you ma'am.
Starting mowing this week. Grass is coming in thick.
Perfect. Please go around the tulips.
Always do.
Hi Mrs. Halvorsen, it's Gary. We'll start mowing this week, weather permitting.
Thank you Gary. Please skip the tomato bed by the fence.
Rain all day tomorrow, I'll come the next day instead if that's OK.
Fine by me.
Will do. Mowed today, trimmed the edges.
Looks great. Check the dandelions by the mailbox.
Got them. Also your gutters have some leaves, want me to clear them for $40?
Yes please. Gus can't climb that ladder anymore and won't admit it.
Ha. Doing it Thursday morning.
Noticed some grubs in the front lawn. I could treat it for $35.
Do it please. Gus saw brown spots and has been grumbling.
Treated. Water it every morning for a week.
Gus will do it. He loves that hose.
Invoice for May: $120. Check or Venmo is fine.
Check in the mail today.
Hot out. Moving you to early morning so I'm done before 9. Hope that works.
Good, Gus is up at five anyway.
Haha, I've noticed. He's always at the window with his coffee.
That's him.
Heads up, rain all week. I'll mow when it dries.
No hurry. The grass can wait.
Gate was latched. Mowed the front only, left a note.
Sorry! He must have locked it. I'll make sure it's open next time.
No problem.
Invoice for June: 4 cuts at $45 plus grub treatment $35 = $215. Pay anytime.
Mailing a check tomorrow.
Mowed. Your hostas look great.
Thanks, Gus gets the credit. He talks to them.
Ha. Whatever he's saying, it works.
Mowed and bagged. Cut the hedge too. Looks sharp.
Got your check. Thank you.
Ilse, I'm so sorry to hear. My mom had you as her hygienist for years. She always said you had the gentlest hands.
I'll keep mowing for Gus. No charge for now. Just leave the gate open.
Mowed this morning. Hostas are still going strong.
Gus, if you see this, I trimmed the hedge too. No charge.
Chippewa Valley Hearing Center: Reminder for Gus Halvorsen, hearing aid check on May 15 at 10:30 AM. Reply C to confirm.
C
Thank you! Please bring the aids and the charging case.
We're ready for Gus. Please check in at the front desk.
We're parked outside. He's refusing to leave the truck until the engine cools 😄
No rush! We'll wait.
Follow-up: How is Gus doing with his adjusted settings? Reply 1-5.
4. He says the television is 'less mumbly'
Wonderful. That's the highest praise 🙂
Your order of size 312 batteries (2 packs) is ready for pickup.
Thank you, Gus will come by this afternoon
We close at 4:30.
He'll be there by 3
Chippewa Valley Hearing Center: Your hearing aid cleaning is scheduled for tomorrow at 1:00 PM.
Thank you. Gus will be coming with me, he keeps saying 'what?'
Ha! We'll check his too. Bring both pairs.
Free community hearing screening, August 8, 9 AM to noon at the Eau Claire Senior Center. Bring a friend.
Thank you. Gus won't go but I'll mention it to a neighbor
Chippewa Valley Hearing Center: Thanks for visiting. Batteries purchased: 2 packs.
Gus says the new setting is too loud. He wants it lowered.
We can adjust remotely or bring him in for a quick tune-up. Which do you prefer?
Bring him in. He doesn't trust anything he can't hold.
Understood! Opening at 3 PM tomorrow works.
Reminder: Gus's cleaning and check is due. Reply to this message to schedule.
Can we do the week after next? Morning is better, he's grumpy in the afternoon
Absolutely. We have August 25 at 9:00 AM.
Booked. Thank you
Chippewa Valley Hearing Center: Is your device whistling? Try replacing the dome. Call us if it persists.
Reminder: Gus Halvorsen, August 25 at 9:00 AM. Reply C to confirm.
C
Gus did great today! His left aid has a new dome, let us know if it feels loose.
He says it feels like nothing, which is the point
Chippewa Valley Hearing Center: Summer special: free cleaning kit with any visit.
Your account has a $38 balance for the new domes. Pay online or at your next visit.
I'll bring a check next time
No problem!
Chippewa Valley Hearing Center: Warranty on your device expires next year. Call to schedule a check-up.
Reminder: Gus Halvorsen has a battery check on September 25 at 10:00 AM. Reply C to confirm or R to reschedule.
We saw a note on the account. Our sincere condolences to Gus and family. We've stopped the automated reminders.
Please disregard the earlier reminder. If Gus still needs batteries, we'll mail them. No charge.
Chippewa Valley Hearing Center: Reminder, your device is due for a cleaning. Reply C to book.
A package of size 312 batteries was mailed to Gus Halvorsen. Please let us know if it doesn't arrive.
Ilse, it's Walt. Gus not picking up his cell again
It's in the truck glovebox, as always 😄 What's up?
Fish fry at the VFW this week. Wondering if he wants to come, I'm driving
He'd love it. Pick him up at 5?
5 it is
He says wear a coat, he's not scraping your windshield
Ha! Fair
Thanks for letting me borrow your husband. He ate three pieces of perch
I could tell. He came home smelling like a fryer and happy
Ilse, you know a good place for a transmission? Truck's slipping
Gus says Ron's Auto Repair, and don't let them upsell the fluid
Tell Gus thanks
Ron says $1,100. Gus said that's about right. I'll live
Gus says measure twice and pay once
Walleye opener coming up. Gus still got the 14-footer?
Still in the garage. He's been sharpening hooks for a week
Sharpening hooks, that man
I told him the fish don't care
They care
Walt, Gus asked if you still have the 3/8 drive socket set he lent you
Got it right here. Bringing it by this weekend
He'll pretend he forgot he lent it
Haha
Ilse, Walt here. Gus mentioned your sump pump is making a noise. I can look at it.
That's kind. He won't ask, so I'm asking for him.
Understood. I'll bring the wrench and the thermos.
Fixed. Float switch was stuck. They had it coming.
Thank you Walt. Come for supper. Pot roast.
Can't say no to pot roast.
Gus caught a northern this morning, nearly 30 inches. He won't text you so I am
I'll act surprised. Thank you!
He threw it back. Said it was too pretty to eat
That sounds like him
Fishing trip is on for next month. Gus in?
I'll make sure he is. He needs the air.
I'll pick him up at five a.m. Sharp.
I'll pack him a thermos and egg sandwiches.
Al Brekke from the shop passed away. You hear?
Oh no. Gus mentioned he'd been poorly. Where's the service?
Lutheran church on Clairemont, ten o'clock
We'll be there. Gus will wear the good flannel
He only has one good flannel 😂
Seriously, Al was a good man. Forty years running the grinder
He was. I'll make a hotdish for the family
Service was nice. Gus stood at the back the whole time
He doesn't do well with these. He was quiet all evening
None of us do. Coffee with him next week, I'll keep him busy
Lawn guy quit on me. Gary does good work, you use him?
Gary's been ours for years. Say Ilse sent you
Will do
Caught four walleye. Gus caught the biggest and didn't say a word. Classic.
He came home smiling. Thank you for that. 🐟
The Fourth was a good one. Gus's brats were something
The secret is the beer. He won't say it out loud
I know the secret. I'll keep it
Gus around? Got a part for his old lathe, found it at an estate sale
He's in the garage, I'll send him out. Come by after lunch
Be there at one
I got word from Pastor Dale. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. I don't know what else to say
Saw Gus at the service. Didn't have words. Sat with him a bit
Taking Gus for coffee tomorrow. He doesn't need to talk. Just thought somebody ought to be looking after him
He fixed my porch rail today without being asked. Never said a word. Just wanted you to know
Coffee tomorrow? The place on Barstow has the cinnamon rolls again.
Yes! 10 o'clock?
Perfect. I'll save us the booth by the window.
Gus is sulking, he wanted me to help with the furnace filter 😄
Furnace filters are a man's love language.
Did you see the library has a new Louise Penny? I put myself on the hold list.
Put me down too. I'm tired of waiting for you to finish them first.
I read fast!
My hip appointment got moved to April. Ugh.
At least it's getting done. Want me to drive you?
Would you? They said I can't drive after.
Of course. Just give me the time.
8:15 check-in. Awful hour.
I'll bring a thermos.
Home. Hip is bionic. Thank you for sitting there all those hours.
Don't mention it. Get some rest. Did they give you the good pills?
They gave me pills that make everything funny.
😂 Text me when you're sober.
Walked to the mailbox today! Victory.
Proud of you. Gus says use the cane or he'll weld you a better one.
He would too.
Ilse, I found the pattern for the baby blanket. Want a copy?
Yes please! Bring it to coffee.
Tomato starts are at Festival Foods, two for five dollars. Want me to grab you some?
Yes please, four Romas and two of the big ones.
Done. Leaving them on your porch.
Found them! Thank you. Gus already dug the bed. He used a level. For dirt.
Joyce says the diner has a new pie. Peach with a lattice top.
Now I want it. Let's go after circle.
My hip is better today. Maybe I can walk the whole path.
Take your cane anyway. Don't be stubborn.
Yes, mother 😂
Did you watch the news about the storm? Hail the size of walnuts out by Chippewa Falls.
Saw it. Our tomatoes survived somehow. Gus covered them with the old tarp.
Good man. Mine are shredded.
I'll bring you some from ours tomorrow.
Thank you, dear. You always do.
Book club pick for July is the one with the lighthouse. Hope you like it, it's long.
I started it. I'm already confused about the sisters.
Everyone is. Keep a list.
Heat advisory! Stay inside. Come over for iced tea, I have the AC.
Be there at three. Bringing the rhubarb bars.
Bring nothing but yourself. The ice is already in the tray.
Too late, they're already in the oven 😄
Thanks for yesterday. I laughed more than I have all month.
Me too. Same again soon.
Ilse, I can't believe it. Pastor Dale called me. I am so sorry. I'm coming over this afternoon with a casserole.
I sat with Gus after the service. He didn't say much. He held my hand. That's all I'll say.
Gus, it's Ruth. I'll leave tomatoes on your porch. No need to answer.
Reminder: Ilse Halvorsen has an appointment with Dr. Patel on April 14 at 9:20 AM. Reply C to confirm, R to reschedule.
C
Thank you. Please arrive 15 minutes early and bring your medication list.
Thanks for visiting Dr. Patel's Office. Lab results will post to your portal within 3 days.
Your lab results are available in the portal. Dr. Patel noted your cholesterol is slightly elevated. Please call to schedule a follow-up.
Hi, this is Ilse. Could I get the follow-up in about 3 months?
Hi Ilse, this is Tammy. Sure, I have July 14 at 10:40.
That works. Thank you, Tammy.
Booked.
Your referral to Lakeview Eye Care has been sent. They will call you to schedule.
Thank you, they already called!
Your refill request was sent to Walgreens. It should be ready within 24 hours.
Thanks Tammy.
Reminder: Ilse Halvorsen has an appointment on July 14 at 10:40 AM. Reply C to confirm, R to reschedule.
C
Thanks for visiting today. Dr. Patel would like you to check your blood pressure at home and call with readings.
Will do, I have a cuff.
Dr. Patel's Office: Your annual wellness visit is scheduled for tomorrow at 10:15 AM. Please arrive 15 minutes early.
Confirmed. Do I need to fast?
Yes, no food after midnight. Water and your regular medications are fine.
Thank you.
Dr. Patel's Office: Your lab results are available on the patient portal.
Dr. Patel would like to review blood pressure readings. Can you log home readings for two weeks?
I can. Mine is usually around 135 over 80 in the morning.
Good. Keep a log and bring it to your follow-up.
Tammy, Gus has had a cough for 2 weeks and won't see anyone. Can he get squeezed in?
We can see him tomorrow at 8:40. Does he have his insurance card?
I'll make sure. He won't want to go, so I'll drive him.
Sounds good.
Dr. Patel's Office: Follow-up appointment booked for the 15th at 2:00 PM. Reply C to confirm.
C
Dr. Patel's Office: Thank you for coming in. Your prescription has been sent to your pharmacy.
Dr. Patel's Office: Please complete your satisfaction survey. It takes one minute.
Home BP readings: 138/84, 142/86, 136/82. Is that OK?
Dr. Patel says those are okay for now. Keep an eye on them and we'll recheck at your next visit.
Thanks.
Reminder: Ilse Halvorsen has an appointment on September 22 at 10:00 AM for a blood pressure recheck. Reply C to confirm, R to reschedule.
C
Reminder: Ilse Halvorsen has an appointment on September 22 at 10:00 AM. Reply C to confirm, R to reschedule.
We missed you at your appointment today. Please call to reschedule.
Hi, this is Tammy from Dr. Patel's Office. We heard from Sacred Heart. We are so very sorry for your loss. We have cancelled all future appointments.
Gus, Dr. Patel asked me to say the door is open if you want to talk about that cough, or anything else.
Eau Claire Senior Center: Spring session registration opens May 12. Chair yoga, watercolor, and quilting circle spots are limited.
Hello, can I sign up for watercolor by text?
Hi Ilse! Yes. Watercolor Beginner, 6 weeks, $24. Want us to hold a spot?
Yes please. And Gus is not interested in anything but the woodshop. Is that open?
The woodshop is open to members most mornings. Gus can drop in any time with a membership card.
Perfect, I'll nudge him
Great. Your watercolor spot is held. Class starts May 19.
Reminder: Watercolor Beginner starts tomorrow at 1:00 PM, Room B. Bring an apron.
Watercolor note: please bring a jar for rinse water next class.
Got it, I'll use a pickle jar
April lunch menu: Swedish meatballs, baked cod, chicken pot pie, and ham with scalloped potatoes. Suggested donation $4. Reply STOP to opt out.
Free blood pressure checks this month from the Sacred Heart outreach team. No appointment needed.
Can I bring a guest to the lunch?
Of course! Guests are welcome for the same suggested donation.
Thank you. I'll bring a friend from the quilt guild
Bus trip to Door County, July 23. $65 includes lunch. Seats left: 6.
I'll pass this time, thank you. We're going up in September with friends
No problem! We'll send September trip info.
Eau Claire Senior Center: Chair yoga is Tuesdays and Thursdays at 9 AM. Reply YES to reserve a mat.
YES
You're on the list! See you Tuesday.
Your membership renews in 30 days: $15/yr. Reply RENEW to confirm.
RENEW
Thanks Ilse! Your membership is renewed through next June.
Reminder: Bingo night is cancelled this week due to the floor waxing.
Reminder: Summer hours begin August 3. Building opens at 8:30 AM.
Eau Claire Senior Center: Lunch menu this week: baked chicken, green beans, rolls, apple crisp. $5 suggested donation.
Can I bring a guest to lunch?
Absolutely, guests are welcome. Just let the front desk know.
June lunch menu: Turkey and gravy, tuna noodle hotdish, brats and kraut, and a cold salad plate. Suggested donation $4.
Watercolor show-and-tell is next week in the lobby. Families welcome. Ilse, your painting of the barn is on the list!
Oh dear. It's a very wonky barn
Wonky barns are the best kind! 😊
Eau Claire Senior Center: Free blood pressure checks on the first Friday of each month.
The watercolor show opens at 2 PM today. Cookies provided.
Gus stood in front of my barn for ten minutes. He said the roofline was square. High praise
That's the best review we've had all week 😊
Eau Claire Senior Center: Summer picnic is coming up. Sign up at the front desk to bring a dish.
Put me down for a fruit salad please.
Done! Thank you, Ilse.
Chair yoga is paused until September 21 while the floor is refinished. Sorry for any inconvenience.
Heat advisory: the Senior Center lobby is open as a cooling station, 9 AM to 5 PM. Please stay hydrated.
Reminder: Fall registration opens October 5. Watch for the catalog in the mail.
Eau Claire Senior Center: We were so sorry to learn of Ilse's passing. Her watercolor classmates are thinking of Gus and the family.
Eau Claire Senior Center: Our new fall class schedule is out. Pick up a copy or ask us to mail one.
Her barn painting is still in our lobby display. We'd be glad to wrap it for Gus if he wants it. No hurry.
Fall catalog is out. This message was sent to the number on file for Ilse Halvorsen. If you have any questions, call the front desk.
Did you two get hit with that snow? We got 9 inches here.
Oh yes. Gus has been out with the blower since six. He won't let anyone help.
That's my brother.
I told him the driveway will still be there at noon. He said 'Not if it freezes.'
He's right.
Of course you'd say that.
Valentine's was quiet here. Tom got me a card AND a poinsettia. Wonders never cease.
Don't spread it around.
Gus gave me a card he signed 'G.' Forty-one years and still just the initial 😄
Aw. That's love, Ilse.
I know it is ❤️
Anyone want the old band saw? Garage is overflowing. Birgit says it goes or I go.
Gus says he'll look at it. Bring it when you come for Easter.
Easter works. Ham or lamb?
Ham. We always do ham.
I'll do the scalloped potatoes and the green bean thing.
The one with the crispy onions? Yes please
Is there another one?
Home safe. Thank you for the leftovers, I'm eating the potatoes cold out of the container.
Take the whole dish next time. Gus likes the saw. He's already taken it apart on the bench.
Of course he has.
Happy Mother's Day to my favorite sister-in-law 🌷
Thank you, Birgit! Same to you. Did the kids call?
Both of them, before 8 am. Tom is still asleep.
I am not.
Mom, Dad's birthday card is in the mail, tell me if it doesn't show.
Will do. Thank you, Tom.
Ilse, are you two coming to the reunion at the lake this year? Mom's recipe for the bars please 🙏
Yes, we'll be there. I'll copy the recipe out by hand.
Doc says my knee needs replacing. Fall maybe.
Oh Tom. Gus will want to bring you soup. He won't say it but he will.
Chili. I take chili.
Noted. 😄
We got the new deck done! Dad would approve of the joints.
He'll want to measure it himself. 😄
Ha! He already asked for photos with a tape measure in frame.
Kids start camp next week. Sending them with too much bug spray.
Better too much than too little. Love to the grandkids ❤️
Fourth of July at the lake? Tom's buying brats.
We'll bring the beans and a pie. Rhubarb or cherry?
Rhubarb!!
Great day. Thank you both. Gus and Tom did not stop talking about that saw 🙄
Men and their tools.
Call you both on Sunday after church?
Yes, come by around two. Gus will have the grill going.
Perfect. We'll bring corn.
Ilse. We just heard from Pastor Dale. We are so sorry. Tom is on the road, we're coming today.
Whatever Gus needs. Anything.
We're at the house. He's out in the garage. Tom's with him.
Gus, if you ever read this on her phone: the hotdish is labeled in your freezer. 350 for an hour.
Gus, knee surgery is set for October. Come by when you can. No hurry.
Ilse! Book club's next pick is the one about the Norwegian immigrants. The library has 6 copies on hold
I'll grab one. Is it long?
480 pages 😬
I'll start tonight. Gus will read the sports page next to me, in solidarity
Ha
Meeting moved to my house, the library's carpet is being replaced
What can I bring?
Just yourself. And maybe those lemon bars?
Lemon bars it is
You're an angel
Everyone loved the bars. Marge asked for the recipe, I said I'd have to pry it from you
It's on the back of the powdered sugar bag. Practically
I've been looking at the wrong bag then!
Who's driving to the author talk in Menomonie?
I can. I'll take Dorothy and Nancy too
Perfect. Leave at 5:30?
5:30 at my house
Bring a sweater, those halls are freezing
That was lovely. Thank you for driving
I enjoyed it. Nancy fell asleep in the car both ways 😂
Don't worry, I won't let on that I know
Next book is a mystery. Light. Thank goodness
I need light. The last one made me cry on the porch

Thank you for the ride and for the pie recommendation. Loved the ending.
Told you!! Next one is a mystery, Marge picked it.
Cold, wet planting weather. Are your tomatoes outside yet?
Not yet. Frost warning tonight. Cover everything!
Gus is out there right now with old bedsheets. 😂
Mine's in a bucket in the garage. Safe and sound.
Ilse, I need your honey-glazed carrot recipe for Sunday. Mine come out like rocks.
Butter, brown sugar, a splash of orange juice. Don't boil them to death!
Genius. Thank you.
Planted everything this morning! Finally. Back is killing me.
Same here. I'm on the porch with a heating pad and iced tea.
We are too old for this and we love it 😅
Ha! Yes.
My sister is having her surgery next week. I'm a nervous wreck.
Oh Elaine. I'll be praying. Call me anytime, day or night.
You're a good friend.
Saw a rose-breasted grosbeak at the feeder! First one this year 😍
Oh how lovely. We've only got the usual chickadees and one very fat squirrel.
Try the black oil sunflower seed. They go crazy for it.
Buying a bag at Fleet Farm tomorrow.
She's out and resting. Doctors say it went well! 🙏
Thank God. I'll send flowers.
Don't spend money, a card is plenty.
Too late, I already ordered tulips 😄
Strawberries are ripe! Come pick some, I can't eat them all.
I'll bring a bowl this afternoon. I owe you a jar of the rhubarb jam.
Oh yes, trade! 🍓
Cards and tulips then. Lunch next week?
Love to. I'll text you the day.
Fireworks at the park on the Fourth. Want to sit together? Bring lawn chairs.
Yes! Gus will grumble about the noise but he'll come. I'll bring bars.
Wonderful. Save me a lemon one. 🍋
Hi, this is Ilse Halvorsen on Birch Street. The water heater in our basement is leaking at the bottom. Can someone come look?
Hi Ilse, Bob here. Shut the water supply valve on top if you can. I can be there tomorrow morning around 9.
Gus already shut it off. He says it's the tank itself, not a fitting.
Probably right. How old is the unit?
Gus says we put it in the year the basement was finished. So a long time. 😅
Then it's done. I'll bring a 40 gallon on the truck just in case.
Thank you Bob. We'll have coffee on.
Running about 20 min late, a pipe froze across town.
No problem at all. Stay warm!
All done. New 40 gallon is in and running. Estimate for the work is in your email.
Got it. Gus wrote you a check, it's on the kitchen table, he'll drop it off today.
Thanks. Keep the tank pressure valve clear, I showed Gus. He knew already. 😄
Bob's Plumbing & Heating: Thank you for choosing us! Please leave a review at the link below.
Left you five stars. Thanks again.
Appreciate it Ilse.
Spring furnace tune-up special: $89 through July 2. Reply YES to book.
YES please. Any morning next week works for us.
I can do the 26th at 10. That okay?
May 28th at 10 is perfect.
Reminder: furnace tune-up tomorrow at 10 am.
Filter was filthy. Changed it. Furnace is fine, good for another year.
Gus said you were quick. High praise from him. 😊
Ha. Tell him measure twice.
He says that to everyone.
Ilse, the kitchen faucet is dripping again after Gus fixed it. Want me to swing by?
Sure. Likely just the cartridge. Can come by after 3 today.
That would be great. I'll hide the pie before Gus sees you. 🥧
On my way.
Cartridge swapped. No charge, I had one in the truck.
Bob, you're a good man. Take the other half of that pie home to Susan.
Won't argue. Thanks.
Bob's Plumbing & Heating: Your furnace tune-up is scheduled for tomorrow between 8 and 10 AM.
Thank you. Gus will be home. He'll hover and ask questions.
Happy to answer them. Bob says your filter is overdue.
Bob's Plumbing & Heating: Thanks for choosing us! Invoice total: $89.00. Pay online or by check.
Heavy rain forecast tonight. Might be a good time to check your sump pump. Offering free pump checks this week for regular customers.
Gus tested it with a bucket last week and says it's good. But I'll take you up on it, the float looks old.
Float is cheap. I'll swap it while I'm there.
Stopping by tomorrow late morning.
Float switch replaced, pump runs great. Poured a bucket, drains clean.
Thank you! Invoice?
$22 for the part. Pay whenever.
Mailing a check today.
The upstairs bathroom faucet is dripping again.
We can come Monday afternoon. Does 1 PM work?
1 PM is fine.
Replaced the cartridge. Should be good as new. Left the old one on the counter.
Gus examined it and nodded. High praise.
Ha. We'll take it.
Bob's Plumbing & Heating: Summer is here! Ask about our outdoor spigot checks. Reply STOP to opt out.
Bob's Plumbing & Heating: Summer special, $20 off any AC check.
Bob's Plumbing & Heating: Thank you for your payment of $64.00.
Petersen Family Dental: Hi Ilse! This is a reminder of your cleaning tomorrow at 9:30 AM. Reply C to confirm.
C
Thank you! See you then. Remember to bring your insurance card.
Running about 10 minutes behind, is that all right?
No problem at all, we'll have you in the chair right away.
Petersen Family Dental: Hi Ilse, this is a reminder of your cleaning on Thursday at 10:30 AM. Reply C to confirm.
C
Thank you! See you Thursday. 🦷
Petersen Family Dental: Thanks for visiting! Your next visit is due in six months. We'll text you in the fall.
Hi Ilse, Karen mentioned you wanted the number of the old hygiene school group. Do you still have it?
I'll dig it out of my address book and send it Monday 😊
Wonderful, no rush.
Petersen Family Dental: Our office will be closed the week of September 5th. For emergencies, call the main line.
Reminder: Ilse H. has a cleaning scheduled on October 13 at 2:00 PM. Reply C to confirm or call to reschedule.
Petersen Family Dental: Your Delta Dental statement is available online.
C
Thank you! See you then.
Hi, this is Karen Petersen. I'm so sorry about Ilse. She trained half my hygienists and the office won't be the same. We've cancelled her appointment.
Petersen Family Dental: Hi Ilse, this is a reminder of your cleaning on September 29 at 9:00 AM. Reply C to confirm, R to reschedule.
Your October 13 appointment has been cancelled. Our office is here if you need anything.
Petersen Family Dental: We haven't heard from you. Please reply C to confirm your visit on September 29.
Petersen Family Dental: Final reminder, your appointment is tomorrow at 9:00 AM. Reply C to confirm.
Petersen Family Dental: We missed you today. Please call 715-555-0171 to reschedule your cleaning.
Petersen Family Dental: Hello, this is Becky at the front desk. Karen told us the sad news. We're so sorry. Please disregard automated reminders. We'll cancel everything on our end.
Petersen Family Dental: Your future appointments have been cancelled.
Petersen Family Dental: Tell your friends! Refer a new patient and receive a $25 gift card.
Petersen Family Dental: Please note our office will be closed for staff training on October 16.
Petersen Family Dental: Gus, if you ever need Ilse's records for anything, call us. We're thinking of you. -Becky
Petersen Family Dental: Gus Halvorsen, we have a balance of $0.00. Thank you!
Gus, we have a plant the staff put together for you. Pick it up any time, or we can drop it by.
Petersen Family Dental: Your account balance is $0.00. Thank you.

messages.title: Helen, Pastor Dale, Grace Lutheran Church Office

msgs.text: Good morning Bridges mentors! Pairings for this year are confirmed: Walt P. & Tyler, Barb K. & Maya, Ilse H. & Jonah.
Thank you, Helen. Same pair as always. 🙂
Reminder: mentor check-in potluck Sunday after service.
Praying for all our mentors and their young people this season.
Did you get the cake recipe I sent? The one with the sour cream.
I did. I'll try it for the church bake sale.
Use real butter. Not the tub stuff.
Yes, Mother.
It's 9 degrees here this morning. Duluth in a nutshell 🥶
It's 24 here and Gus is already complaining about the driveway.
Tell him to buy a plow like a normal person.
He says he'll fix the snowblower. He's said that since October.
Are you two still coming up for Christmas?
We'll come up the day before. Gus wants to leave by seven so we beat the weather.
Of course he does. I'll have the spare room made up.
Thank you for having us. Gus hasn't stopped talking about your ham.
Gus called me Sunday to say Happy New Year, early. Gus still tells everyone about you and that deer in the old Buick, ha.
He does. I'd rather he didn't. How's your knee?
Ilse, that was twenty years ago. You can laugh about it by now.
I know. Tell me about the knee.
Fine, fine. Doctor says it's age. I told him that's not a diagnosis.
Sent you a photo of Kari's baby. Look at those cheeks! 😍
Oh, she's a darling. Looks just like Kari did.
You sound tired lately. Everything all right?
Just not sleeping well. It's nothing.
You always say it's nothing.
Gus, honey, it's Ruth. I'm writing to Ilse's number because it's the only one I know you'll see. I'm so sorry. I keep reaching for the phone to tell her something.
The service was lovely. Pastor Dale did right by her. I'm sorry I had to drive back that night.
You don't have to answer this. Just know I'm here, whatever you need. Casseroles, a ride, somebody to sit.
She was the best of us, Gus. I hope you know that.
I called the house and it rang and rang. If you're not picking up, that's all right. I'll try again next week.
Reminder everyone: quilt raffle tickets are due at the next circle. Please bring your stubs.
I sold twelve already! My neighbor bought six, bless her.
I have the Ohio Star top finished. Need someone to help with the binding.
I can help with the binding. Bring it to circle.
You're a lifesaver, Ilse 🧵
Who's bringing the bars this time?
I'll bring lemon bars.
I'll do the coffee. Someone remember the cream this time.
The raffle brought in $640 for the food pantry. Thank you all!
Wonderful news 🎉
Fabric swap next month at the church hall. Dig out your scraps.
I'll bring the blues. Too many blues in my cupboard.
Quilting this week is at Barb's. Bring your scraps for the baby quilt.
I have a bag of blue and yellow flannels. Will that work?
Perfect. Dorothy has the batting.
I'll bring it in my trunk. It's huge!
Coffee and my oatmeal cookies will be waiting
Barb, your cookies have raisins. Some of us have opinions about raisins.
Elaine, I'll make half with chocolate chips. Happy?
Delighted 😄
Thanks for hosting, Barb. The binding is done on the baby quilt!
It's gorgeous. Who's going to deliver it?
I'll take it to the hospital gift shop on my way home from the senior center.
Is circle still on this month? The hall is getting new carpet.
It's moved to the fellowship room. Same time.
Thank you, Nancy. I'll tell Dorothy, she never reads these.
I read them! Sometimes. 😄
The guild show is in September. Anyone entering a piece?
I'm finishing the log cabin. It's been in a basket for two years.
Ilse, that's the one with the red centers? It's lovely, finish it!
I'll bring it next time so you can all nag me.
We'll nag with love ❤️
We're all thinking of Gus. The circle is making him a quilt from Ilse's favorite scraps.
Count me in for the borders. ❤️
Ilse, did you get the Christmas letter? I wasn't sure the address was right.
It came yesterday. Lovely as always. The photo of the grandkids made me smile.
Dennis is getting his hip done in March. Say a prayer.
Of course. Let me know if you need anything sent up.
He's home and grumpy, which means he's healing 😅
Good grumpy is the best kind.
Did you see Pastor's email about the new hymnals? Apparently they're ordering 100.
I did. I'm just glad the large-print ones are included this time.
Ruth will be thrilled, she's been squinting for years
My sister's coming for a visit next week. Want to do coffee at the bakery?
I'd love to. Name a time and I'll be there.
Ten o'clock the morning after she arrives. I'll text you the day.
Coffee was lovely. Your sister is a hoot.
She says the same about you. She wants your cinnamon roll recipe.
I'll mail it. It's mostly butter and patience.
My tomatoes are finally coming in. Want some?
Yes! Gus has been asking for BLTs for a week.
I'll drop a bag on your step tomorrow.
Got them, they're beautiful. Thank you 🍅
Enjoy! Don't refrigerate them, they lose their flavor.
Yes ma'am. Counter and a paper towel.
See you at Circle 🙂
Ruth told me. I'm so sorry about Ilse. I'm writing to this number in case Gus sees it.
Ilse, can you remind me which Halvorsen cousin lives in Madison? I'm making the Christmas card list.
That's Tom's brother Erik. I'll text you the address.
Thank you. You keep this family together.
Happy Easter to you and Gus 🐣
And to you, Birgit. We're having ham, like every year.
Ilse, I found those old photos of Mormor's kitchen. Want me to scan them for you?
Yes please! I'd love copies. Gus remembers that stove fondly, believe it or not.
He's the only man who ever loved a wood stove that much 😂
Scans are in the mail. There's one of Tom and Gus as boys with a fish bigger than both of them.
I can't wait to see that. He'll pretend he doesn't care and then frame it.
How are you holding up with the heat? My AC is on the fritz.
Gus has the box fans going in every window. He says the AC is a luxury, then sits in front of the vent.
Same household, different state 😄
Bob's Plumbing & Heating says they can come look at mine next week.
Good outfit. They did our water heater and never overcharged.
AC fixed! It was just a capacitor. $140.
Thank goodness. Gus says capacitors are the easiest thing to swap, he'd have done it for free.
Tell him thanks for the offer, but I'm not letting a 70-year-old on my roof 😂
Wise woman.
Call me Sunday after church? I want to hear about the ice cream social.
Will do. There will be fudge to report on.
Tom just called me. I can't believe it. Tell Gus we'll be at the funeral.
Ilse, did you get your garbage cart out? Truck came early.
Gus just wheeled it out. Thank you Marge!
Good. Last time the Hendersons' dog got into theirs and it was a mess.
My peonies are blooming. Come cut some for your table whenever.
Oh I'd love that. I'll come by after supper with scissors 🌸
Take as many as you like. The ants are a nuisance but the smell is worth it.
Have you seen the new people at the corner house? They've got a trampoline.
I saw it. Gus said the springs look rusty. He wanted to go over and look at them, I had to stop him.
😂 That man cannot see a machine without fixing it
Can I borrow your hedge trimmer? Mine died.
Sure. It's in the garage, Gus will bring it over. Be careful, it's got a mean kick.
He just brought it. He also sharpened the blade without being asked.
That's Gus.
Heads up, the city is paving our street next week. No parking on the south side.
Thank you for the warning. I'll tell Gus to move the truck into the drive.
Are you going to the block party on the 4th? Dennis is doing brats.
We'll watch from our back step this year. But I'll send over a pan of bars.
Seven-layer? You spoil us.
Whatever's left from the Circle meeting 😉
The brats were a hit. Dennis burned his thumb but he's proud.
We saw the fireworks from the step. The kids on Birch Street did a good show.
Your pan came back clean, thank you!
Something's been digging in my flower bed. Think it's a raccoon?
Could be skunks looking for grubs. Gus says sprinkle cayenne.
I'll try it. Thank you both.
Our power flickered about 3 a.m. Did yours?
Yes, the stove clock was blinking when I got up. Gus is resetting every clock in the house.
Mine too. Forty-one years in this house and I still can't set the oven clock.
I'm bringing you rhubarb crisp this afternoon. Tom's wife's recipe, but I fixed it.
I will be on the porch with a fork 😄
Dennis says thank you, he had two helpings.
That makes my day.
Good morning ladies! Reminder that Circle meets in the fellowship hall next week at 1:00. Please sign up for bars.
I'll bring lemon bars
Put me down for the coffee. I'll bring the big urn.
I can do seven-layer bars. Hope that's not too many sweets 😄
There's no such thing as too many sweets at Circle, Ilse
Thank you all! Pastor Dale will stop in at the end to say the blessing.
Does anyone have the recipe for that green bean casserole from the funeral lunch last fall?
That was Helen's I think
It was! Cream of mushroom, French's onions, a little Worcestershire. No secret. I'll type it up.
Worcestershire! That's what I was missing 🙌
Quilt raffle tickets are in. Ten dollars for a book of six. Please take a few to sell at your bridge groups.
I'll take two books
I'll take three. Frank at the barbershop will buy at least one.
Prayer chain: Evelyn Strand is home from rehab. Cards welcome, but no visitors yet.
Will do. I'll drop a card at the office to get signed.
Does anyone know if the rummage sale is still the second weekend of June?
Yes, Friday and Saturday. We need folks to price on the Thursday evening before.
I'll come at 5 and help price. I have a box of old Pyrex to donate too.
Pyrex goes fast! Put the primary colors by the front door.
We made $812 at the rummage sale! Thank you everyone. The missionary fund is grateful.
Wonderful!! My feet are still recovering 😅
Mine too. Gus made me soak them and then fell asleep in his chair first.
Bless him
Next month's Bible study is on Ruth. Bring your own Bible and a highlighter.
Which Ruth, Ruth Lindqvist? 😂 She'd love that
The book of Ruth, Patty. But yes she'll be thrilled either way.
Hot tip: the Tuesday morning crowd at Festival Foods has the casserole dishes on sale
Thanks Helen, I need a 9x13 anyway. Mine cracked.
Who's on for communion setup this month? I have a conflict on the 12th.
I can take it, Patty. Just send me the altar guild checklist.
Bless you Helen. Attaching it now.
July Circle will be an ice cream social instead of a meeting. Bring a topping.
Hot fudge, I'll bring it in a crockpot to keep it warm
I'll bring sprinkles and the cherries
Butterscotch for me. Someone has to.
The church directory is being updated. Please check your entry in the office binder and send any changes.
Will do next time I'm in.
Weather looks good for the ice cream social. Mid 70s!
The Lord provides 🙏
See you all soon!
Ilse! It's Karen from the old office. Got your number from Marge. How are you?
Karen Petersen! Of course. I'm good, retired life is busy, can you believe it? How are you and the practice?
Still scraping teeth, God help me. Dr. Petersen is cutting back to four days. We hired a young hygienist, sweet girl, but she doesn't know how you did the old schedule book.
😂 Paper and pencil, never failed me.
We're doing a little retirement potluck for Dolores at the end of the month. Would love to see you.
I wouldn't miss it. What's the date and what should I bring?
The 29th, noon, in the break room. Bring a dessert if you can.
Perfect. Seven-layer bars again?
PLEASE. People still talk about them.
Thanks for coming today! It was like old times. Dolores cried at the card.
I loved it. Please tell Dr. Petersen his new chairs are lovely. Still smells like fluoride varnish in there 😄
Some things never change. Would you ever want to sub for a few hours? We're desperate on Fridays.
Oh Karen, my license lapsed after I retired. And my wrists aren't what they were.
Had to ask! Worth a shot.
Quick question. My crown on the lower left has been sensitive to cold. Should I call or wait it out?
Call. Don't wait. I can squeeze you in Thursday morning if you want.
Thursday works. 9:30?
Booked. Don't eat ice cream before 😉
Just a little recession in the gum, nothing serious. Thanks for the fluoride trays!
Use them every night for two weeks. Bossy hygienist voice 😂
You can take the hygienist out of the office...
Do you remember Mr. Brekke who always brought us pickles from his garden?
Dill pickles in a Mason jar, every August! Of course.
His daughter dropped a jar off today. He passed in the spring. I cried at the front desk.
Oh Karen. He was a gentle man. Please give her my love.
I will. Anyway, lunch soon? My treat, there's a new soup place by the river.
I'd like that. Maybe in a couple weeks, things are busy at church right now.
No rush. Just don't disappear on me like last time 🙂
I promise. I'm bad at keeping in touch but I'm trying.
Soup place has a tomato basil that's supposed to be heaven. Thinking next week?
Let me check with Gus about the truck. Can I let you know in a couple days?
Of course!
Gus says yes, he'll manage on his own for an afternoon. How about the 15th?
The 15th! Perfect, I'll make a reservation for 12:30.
Ilse, Gus not picking up. Tell him the walleye are biting up at Lake Chetek if he wants to come up.
He left the phone in the truck again. I'll pass it on.
Figures 😂
He says he'll bring the good minnow bucket. Said it in about four words.
That's a speech for him
Can we come up the weekend after next? Gus wants to leave early so he beats the road work on 53.
Sure. Spare room's made up. Sheila says bring that rhubarb thing.
Rhubarb crisp, coming right up. I froze some from last June.
Got home. Gus slept the whole way back, snoring like a lathe 😴
Ha! Thanks for coming. He caught the biggest one, don't let him tell you otherwise. Which he won't.
He's already cleaning the reel on the kitchen table. Newspaper everywhere.
How's his knee been? He was favoring it on the dock.
Same. He won't see Dr. Patel about it. Says it's just 38 years of standing on concrete.
Mom said the same thing about her hip till she couldn't stand up
I know. I made him an appointment anyway. He doesn't know yet 🤫
Atta girl
Did you see the Packers schedule? Opener is at home.
I don't follow it but Gus will have it on the fridge by tonight.
Sheila's sister is in the hospital in Duluth, gallbladder. We'll be down there a few days.
Oh no, give her our love. Want me to send a hotdish to the freezer at your place?
Ha, you're two hundred miles away. But bless you.
Then I'll just send prayers and a card. Which one's the sister's address?
Just send it to our house, Sheila will take it over.
Done, it goes out in the morning mail.
She's home and grumpy about the diet. That's a good sign.
Grumpy is how you know they're healing 🙂
Gus got the truck inspection done. Passed. He wants you to know the brakes are "fine."
Fine is high praise from a machinist
Fourth of July, are you two going to the lake or staying put?
Staying put. Gus likes the fireworks from the back step. He says the neighbors' kids do them better than the city anyway.
Fair enough. Keep your hose handy 😄
Already coiled by the door.
Saw a bald eagle on the way to the store today. Thought of Gus, he always points them out.
He'll want the exact mile marker. 🦅
Mile 41. Tell him it was on a dead oak.
I'll pass it along tonight over supper.
Ilse, the Sunday school fall schedule is out. Can you do the nursery rotation again?
I can do the first and third Sundays. Gus has his Packers game on the others 😉
The Packers aren't even playing in the spring, Ilse.
Don't tell him that.
Ha! Fine, first and third it is. Thank you.
We need volunteers for Vacation Bible School. Do you still have the felt board with the animals?
In the hall closet. The giraffe is missing a leg but the kids don't mind.
I'll swing by and get it this week. Thank you!
Picked up the felt board. Gus insisted on carrying it to my car even though it weighs nothing.
He's old school 🙂
He also fixed the squeak on my trunk lid. I didn't even ask.
That's how he says hello.
Can you help with snack at VBS? Goldfish crackers and juice, 25 kids.
Yes. I'll get the juice boxes at Festival Foods, they're buy-one-get-one this week.
You're a lifesaver.
VBS day one done. One kid threw up on the felt giraffe 😭
Oh no! I'll wash it at home. It can go on delicate.
Bless you. Tomorrow's craft is paper plate lambs.
I have cotton balls at home, I'll bring a whole bag.
VBS is finished. 31 kids by the end. Pastor was thrilled.
Wonderful. Those lambs were adorable.
Reminder: the church picnic is at Carson Park on the 26th. Sign up for potato salad or buns.
I'll do the potato salad. Mustard, not mayo, the way Gus likes.
Some of us like mayo, Ilse 😅
I'll make a small bowl of each.
You're too kind.
The sound system in the sanctuary is cutting out again. Could Gus take a look? Not asking, just wondering if he's up for it.
He'd be glad to. He's been bored since he got the garage organized. I'll bring him Sunday.
Wonderful! The tech volunteer is nineteen and keeps unplugging things at random.
Gus will love him. Or lecture him. Possibly both.
Ilse! The tomatoes are going crazy this year. Want some? I can't give them away fast enough.
It's only May, Linda! 😄 Yours are early. Mine are barely up to my knee.
Greenhouse seedlings from the co-op. Worth every penny.
I'll walk over this afternoon and take a look. Gus wants to see your trellis anyway.
Come at 3, I'll have the coffee on.
Did you hear the Sandersons are selling their house? The sign went up this morning.
No! Forty years on this street. I'll miss seeing her wave from the porch.
Their son wants them closer to Madison. Makes sense I suppose.
We should bring a hotdish before they go.
Agreed. I'll do the bars if you do the hotdish.
Walk tomorrow morning? Seven, before it gets hot?
Seven is fine. My knee has been grumbling but I'll go slow.
Slow is my speed too. I'll meet you at the mailboxes.
Bringing you a bag of tomatoes and cucumbers on the way back.
You spoil us, Linda. Thank you.
Hi Mrs. Halvorsen, Gary Nystrom Lawn Care. Starting the spring cleanup route. Can I come by this week?
Hello Gary. Yes please. Gus can't do the heavy raking anymore, though he'd never admit it.
Understood. I'll be there Thursday morning around 8.
Done! Cleaned the beds, hauled the branches. Invoice will come in the mail.
Looks beautiful. Thank you. Gus stood on the porch inspecting your edging.
Did he approve?
He said "Straight." That's an A+.
I'll take it 😄
Summer mowing schedule starts next week, every other week unless it's rainy. Same price as last year.
That's fine. Please skip the back strip by the fence, Gus likes to do that one himself.
Got it. Skipping the fence strip.
Mowed today. Noticed some brown patches near the maple. Could be grubs. Want me to treat?
Yes, please treat it. How much extra?
Thirty-five for the application. Safe for pets and kids.
Go ahead. Thank you.
Rain all day tomorrow, I'll push your mow to the day after.
No trouble. The grass will be glad for the rain.
Mowed. The patch near the maple is coming back green.
Good to hear. Gus is relieved. He was ready to dig up the whole thing.
Next mow is the 5th. Heads up the city is trimming trees on your block that week, could be some mess.
Thanks for the warning. Mow whenever works for you.
Mowed and swept the walk. The city crew left a pile of branches by your curb, I can haul it for a small fee.
The city usually picks those up. Let's wait a few days and see.
Sounds good. Let me know if they don't.
Bob's Plumbing & Heating here. Confirming your furnace tune-up for Thursday between 9 and 11.
Thank you, that works. Please use the side door, the front steps are icy.
Will do. Our tech Kyle will call 20 minutes before arriving.
Thanks for having us. Your furnace is in good shape. Filter replaced. Invoice sent to your email.
Received, thank you. Gus says the pilot assembly looked fine to him too. 😄
Ha, tell him he's welcome to apply.
Hello, the basement has a small puddle near the sump pump after last night's rain. Could someone come look?
Sorry to hear that. We can send someone tomorrow morning around 8:30. Does that work?
Yes please. Gus will be home.
Tech found the float switch stuck. Replaced it, tested it. Pump is running fine now.
Wonderful. Thank you for coming so fast.
Reminder: our annual water heater flush special is running through the end of July. Reply YES to schedule.
YES
Great! We have an opening on the 22nd of September at 10 AM. Should we book it?
That works, thank you.
Morning Ilse. Are you still good for altar guild the first Sunday of April? Need to finalize the sheet.
Good morning Pastor. Yes, put me down. I'll bring the good linens, they came back from the cleaners.
Wonderful. Also, would you be willing to help with the Lenten soup supper again? Last year's split pea was a hit.
I can do the split pea and two loaves of bread. Gus will want to taste test, of course.
Ha! Tell Gus he's welcome to the first bowl.
Pastor, the food pantry shelf in the basement is nearly bare. Do you want me to pick up canned goods at Festival Foods on Thursday?
That would be a blessing. Keep the receipt and Pat in the office will reimburse you.
No need, it's my pleasure. I'll just drop it all at the side door.
Reminder: the church council meets tonight at 6:30. We're discussing the roof repair bids.
Thank you, Pastor. I'm not on council but I'll ask Gus to look at the bids. He knows his flashing from his shingles.
I would welcome his eye. Two of the bids look suspiciously low.
He says measure twice and never take the cheapest one. 😊
Sound advice. Thank you both. See you Sunday.
Pastor, can you add the Hendricks family to the prayer list? Their mother is in rehab after the hip surgery.
Of course, Ilse. I'll mention them Sunday. Thank you for always remembering.
Ilse, it's Judy. Got your number from Barb. Are you coming to the hygienists' reunion lunch?
Judy Olund! It's been ages. Where is it this year?
The Olive Garden by the mall. Eleven thirty on the 18th of June. Dr. Petersen's old crew is coming, even Marlene.
I wouldn't miss it. Marlene still owes me a story about the day the autoclave flooded the break room.
😂 She tells it better every year.
That was lovely. My cheeks hurt from laughing. Thank you for organizing.
Same here. We should do it twice a year instead of once.
Fall then. I'll start asking around in September.
Hey, quick question. Who did you see for your crown after you left the practice? My new dentist is rough.
Dr. Haugen on Clairemont. Gentle hands and he actually numbs you properly.
Perfect, I'll call tomorrow. Thank you!
Went to Dr. Haugen. You were right. No jaw ache at all.
Told you. Old hygienist knows best. 😊
How's Gus? Still out in the garage every day?
Every day. He's rebuilding a lathe someone gave him. My wife is a patient woman, he says. I say he has no choice.
Hi Ilse! Are you still planning to visit St. Paul in the fall?
We might. Gus doesn't like the highway, but I'll work on him.
Bring him anyway. I'll make the pot roast he likes.
Sent you the recipe for the cardamom bread. Don't skip the braid.
Got it. I'll bake it Saturday.
How did it turn out??
Gus ate half the loaf before it cooled. Five stars.
Mom, remember I'm driving down for the weekend? Is the guest bed still the lumpy one?
I bought a new mattress topper. No more lumps 😄
You're the best. I'll bring the kids' swimsuits in case we go to the lake.
Dad is already looking for his life jackets.
Of course he is 😂 Tell him the small ones are in the shed.
Thanks for the weekend! The kids are still talking about the pancakes.
Come back anytime. Grandpa asked who's going to teach him to fish with the new reel now.
Next time we'll bring the poles. Love you both.
Quick favor, can you send me Grandma's meatball recipe? Norwegian style.
Allspice, nutmeg, and a little cream. I'll photocopy the card and mail it. You know I don't trust phones for recipes.
😂 Mail is fine, Mom.
The recipe's in the mail. It has a grease stain on it, that's how you know it's real.
Perfect ❤️
How's Dad's knee? He said it was fine on the phone, which means it isn't.
You know him well. I'm working on getting him in to see the doctor.
Good luck. Use guilt if necessary.
